source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and c * 2 + 1 == w)
    left = [row[:split] for row in grid]
    right = [row[split + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    mismatch = max(common, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in left for x in row) + sum(x == v for row in right for x in row))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else mismatch for c in range(split)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p, p.exists())
